summary: Payments - Receipt not displaying when you click print invoice and receipt.
reported_issue: Immediately after a payment processes, clicking 'Print Invoice and Receipt' does not show/display the receipt (the receipt does not appear). The plain 'Print Receipt' button was also flagged for review.
expected_after_fix: After a payment processes, clicking 'Print Invoice and Receipt' (and 'Print Receipt') correctly displays/generates the receipt document.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the flow: the reported defect occurs in the post-payment success screen of a ShopPay/Stripe payment - immediately after a charge processes you click 'Print Invoice and Receipt' and the receipt fails to display.
actual_now: Reaching the 'Print Invoice and Receipt' control in the reported state requires completing a live ShopPay/Stripe payment to land on the post-payment success dialog where that button appears. The automated harness cannot process a real card payment (no live Stripe charge / card entry), so the immediate post-payment receipt-display path cannot be exercised end-to-end here.
notes: Depends on a completed live ShopPay/Stripe payment to reach the post-payment 'Print Invoice and Receipt' action. Not reproducible in the harness without processing a real card charge. Referenced Loom repro in the ticket. Recommend a manual re-check after a test ShopPay payment.
